description: See which agent spawned which thread. A sidebar thread list where child threads nest under the thread that started them, at any depth, and a parent folds its subtree into one line that counts each state. A search field on top (or /) finds threads by title, branch, PR number or project, above counts of threads that need input, failed, are running or are unread. Needs you collects threads asking a question, failed turns, threads stuck with no progress, unread results, failing PRs and failed automations, with Retry, Stop and snooze in place. Running rows show the current step, a turn timer and a high context fill. Orchestrations gives a shortcut to each thread running subthreads, with its progress. Provider subagents (Claude Code Agent calls, Codex subagents) show as a counter on the parent's row with type, state, duration and tokens on hover. Threads group by project or status and sort by last activity, creation date or status, with per-folder overrides; quiet threads fold into an "N older" line you can archive at once. Folded Pull requests (with the GitHub Folder plugin) and Automations sections summarize themselves in the header. Each row stays one line: bb's own status glyph, the title and the agent provider, plus a tinted PR icon only when the pull request needs action. A ⚠ marks a thread whose branch or worktree another live thread is using. Hovering a row shows Archive and its menu; hovering a running spinner lets you stop it. Reads thread data on the bb server; PR status comes from GitHub.
